dimensions.assessment: Affects uranium enrichment facility applicants, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, state governors, local governments, and certain Indian Tribes.
dimensions.evidence: the Governor of the State in which the uranium enrichment facility is to be located

dimensions.assessment: Allows pre-license construction entirely at the applicant's risk and changes hearing requirements, altering the procedural steps for facility development.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this section prohibits the construction of a uranium enrichment facility prior to issuance of a license

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending or revenue changes are detailed in the text.
Amends Section 193 of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 and requires the Nuclear Regulatory Commission to promulgate revised regulations.
dimensions.evidence: the Commission shall promulgate regulations to revise part 70 of title 10, Code of Federal Regulations

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory amendments and ongoing regulatory revision processes.

missing_information: Specific fiscal estimates or costs associated with the regulatory changes.
importance_detail.rationale: S. 5249 modifies licensing and pre-construction rules for uranium enrichment facilities under the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, affecting applicants, regulatory bodies, and local stakeholders.
